title: Installation.
officialText:
All indirect waste piping shall discharge through an air gap or air break into a waste receptor or standpipe. Waste
receptors and standpipes shall be trapped and vented and shall connect to the building drainage system. All indirect waste piping that
exceeds 2 feet (610 mm) in developed length measured horizontally, or 4 feet (1219 mm) in total developed length, shall be trapped.
